item_name: Rothco Thin Blue Line Adjustable Boonie Hat
item_short_desc: Wear your support of the police and law enforcement officials proudly with Rothco’s Thin Blue Line Boonie Hat.
description: Wear your support of the police and law enforcement officials proudly with Rothco’s Thin Blue Line Boonie Hat with features the Thin Blue Line US Flag directly embroidered on to the hat. The boonie hat is also adjustable and features an elastic cord which allows it to fit most head sizes (6 3/4 - 7 3/4). Proceeds From This Purchase Benefit Families Of Fallen First Responders.
